svg.text: 16× M5×6.5 BLIND — 1.5 MIN TO BOND FACE
M5 tapped holes (16×), blind from the choke
1. INTERPRET PER ASME Y14.5-2018. UNITS mm. UNLESS NOTED: X.X ±0.2, X.XX ±0.05.
2. BREAK ALL EDGES 0.2-0.4 UNLESS NOTED. NO BURRS.
3. VENT ALL BLIND HOLES IN VACUUM-EXPOSED PARTS PER DR-6 (spec/00).
4. PROVENANCE: EVERY DIMENSION TRACES PER THE SIDECAR PROVENANCE FILE OF THIS DRAWING (AIEF).
5. MI HEATER ELEMENT GROOVES: TWO COUNTER-SPIRALS, BOTTOM FACE; EXACT PATH PER ROUTING RECORD.
6. BOND FACE (TOP): Ra ≤ 0.8, FLAT 0.05 — ESC ELASTOMER BOND (HP-IF-4).
CLEAN PER SEMI; NO ANODIZE ON BOND FACE
